item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera sees the water in a steel glass outside disappear on a hot afternoon. She thinks about what she could do next.

Only one of these ways of thinking counts as doing science.

Which row shows a way of thinking that is science, and a way of thinking that is not science?

options.A: science: remembering the definition of evaporation from the textbook; not science: asking where the water went
options.B: science: asking where the water went and watching the glass each day; not science: only memorising the definition of evaporation
options.C: science: only memorising the definition of evaporation; not science: asking where the water went and watching the glass
options.D: science: asking where the water went; not science: watching the glass each day to find out
